entries.summary: Initial repo creation. Added README, CLAUDE.md, TODO, protocols (Flywheel, Memory), definition, and Matt Prime agent.

Added SWEAT440 brand law document and competitive intelligence agent. Brand law covers name formatting, forbidden words, positioning anchor, typography, and color palette. Competitive agent is scoped to weekly sweeps of F45, OrangeTheory, Solidcore, and Barry's, producing internal-only decision-ready briefs.

Ran first competitive sweep. Researched F45, OrangeTheory, Solidcore, and Barry's for the week of 2026-05-24. Key findings: OTF launching Season of Strength challenge (June 1–July 26, $35 registration); Solidcore expanded Core Collective wellness partnership program; Barry's hit 100 studios and launched LIFT strength-only modality; F45 sustaining 'This Is F45 Training' global campaign. All four competitors are converging on strength positioning and lifestyle ecosystem expansion. Three decision options surfaced for Matt's review.

Added reporting agent. Consolidation-only agent that reads other agents' weekly brief outputs and produces a single decision-ready scorecard. No web searches, no new findings. Saves scorecards to agents/reporting/scorecards/YYYY-MM-DD.md and follows full Memory write-back protocol.

Vendored the SWEAT440 paid-ad-review skill into the repo and added the missing StoryBrand 2.0 reference. The skill's SKILL.md referenced references/storybrand-framework.md but the file did not exist in any copy, and the active installed copy had lost its references/ folder entirely. Wrote storybrand-framework.md (reader-as-hero rule, seven beats, pillar-to-internal-problem and pillar-to-transformation mappings, one-pillar enforcement, review checklist), repaired the installed copy and the downloadable .skill bundle, added a v2.0 version comment to SKILL.md, and committed the full skill source to skills/sweat440-paid-ad-review/ as the version-controlled source of truth. Verified by running the skill on a sample ad — StoryBrand checks fired correctly.

Kicked off the SWEAT440 community app project. Wrote the project brief (three core loops: dating-app-style profiles + studio boards/events, studio WOD + in-home custom workouts, CRM-tied rewards with referrals as the flagship mechanic; retail/nutrition/matching explicitly out of scope for prototype). Built clickable prototype v1 as a self-contained HTML mobile mockup with working tab navigation, profile create/edit with home-studio dropdown, community board/members/events, WOD + in-home workout generator, rewards with referral code, and a stub AI concierge chat. Verified in browser preview (all interactions pass, no console errors) and published as a Claude artifact. Biggest open question: which CRM SWEAT440 uses and what its API exposes.

CRM confirmed: SWEAT440 runs on Mindbody. Verified via web research that Mindbody Public API v6 + Webhooks cover both critical needs: GetClientVisits/GetClassVisits for check-in data (streaks + points) and the ReferredBy field on client profiles (present in client.created webhook payloads) for referral attribution. Updated the app brief with a Mindbody integration section and replaced the open CRM question with a concrete next action: register a developer account, get sandbox access, and confirm whether the franchise is one Mindbody site with many locations or site-per-franchisee.
